pending.title: Split Composition Portrait Collage
pending.prompt: Create a realistic split-composition artistic portrait collage of the person in the photo. On the right side, show a large close-up portrait of the person smiling warmly, with dark curly quiff hair, light stubble, soft green eyes, and wearing an open-collar [SHIRT_COLOR: olive green] linen shirt with layered gold necklaces. On the left side, show a full-body shot of the same person wearing a matching olive green shirt, green trousers, and white sneakers, posing leaning back. The background features an artistic [BACKGROUND_STYLE: watercolor splash paint] texture in earthy green and off-white tones, blending behind both figures. Use smooth lighting, realistic skin texture, and a highly detailed editorial aesthetic. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged, preserving their exact facial features, hair, and natural appearance exactly as shown in the photo.
